name: diegma/trip-maml (Trip-MAML)
what_it_holds: Trip-MAML: a Multi-Aspect Multi-Lingual academic dataset of TripAdvisor hotel reviews in English, Italian and Spanish, annotated at the sentence level for aspect-oriented opinion mining (not the generic single-language Kaggle 20k file).
why_useful: A genuine multilingual academic replication package rather than a reskin of the well-known Kaggle set; could support cross-region hotel sentiment/aspect comparisons (EMEA/LatAm language coverage) distinct from anything currently held.
size_hint: sentence-level annotated corpus, 3 languages (exact row count not confirmed without cloning)
themes: TripAdvisor datasets: hotel/vacation-rental reviews, review velocity, TripAdvisor rentals, scraper repos

name: factden/tripadvisor-hotel-reviews-api
what_it_holds: Apify-actor source code (MIT licensed) that pulls per-review data from TripAdvisor hotels/restaurants/attractions/airlines: rating, title, full text, language + machine-translation flag, reviewer profile, owner responses, sub-ratings (rooms, cleanliness, etc.), plus property records (rankings, amenities, address, TripAdvisor AI-generated review summaries). Repo commits real committed sample output: reviews.sample.json, places.sample.json, and a CSV from a live 'W Barcelona' run. Usage-based paid pricing (~$0.45/1,000 reviews, ~$2.00/1,000 property records) beyond a free monthly credit tier; global city/country filtering via 'Discover' mode. Does NOT cover TripAdvisor vacation rentals, only hotels/restaurants/attractions.
why_useful: A maintained, documented, MIT-licensed method to pull fresh TripAdvisor hotel review counts and text at low marginal cost, city-filterable -- usable as a review-velocity nowcast input for competitor hotel demand (parallel to the ABNB reviews-based stays index already built over 123 Inside Airbnb markets). Has real committed sample data to inspect the schema without paying.
license: MIT (code); Apify platform usage is metered/paid beyond free tier
time_coverage: Live/current pulls only, not historical archive
size_hint: sample files only (few KB); production pulls scale to any size at cost
duplicate_of_holding: None (new method for hotel review velocity)
themes: TripAdvisor datasets: hotel/vacation-rental reviews, review velocity, TripAdvisor rentals, scraper repos
why_all: A maintained, documented, MIT-licensed method to pull fresh TripAdvisor hotel review counts and text at low marginal cost, city-filterable -- usable as a review-velocity nowcast input for competitor hotel demand (parallel to the ABNB reviews-based stays index already built over 123 Inside Airbnb markets). Has real committed sample data to inspect the schema without paying.

name: INN Hotels Group Reservations (ahsan81 Kaggle mirror)
what_it_holds: 36,275 reservation rows, 19 features, for an unnamed Indian hotel chain ('INN Hotels Group') sourced originally from Kaggle (ahsan81/hotel-reservations-classification-dataset). Fields include lead time, arrival date, number of adults/children, weekend/week nights, meal plan, room type, market segment, average price per room, special requests, and booking-status (cancelled/not-cancelled) target — CSV format, MIT-style permissive Kaggle mirror, 57,080 Kaggle downloads per HF card. Not on GitHub itself (found via Hugging Face's dataset API since GitHub/web search engines were rate-limited or blocked this session); several other HF mirrors of the same underlying Kaggle set also exist (Omrihahami/HotelReservationsDataset, sanjula153/Hotel-Reservation-Dataset, Brbg/Hotel_Reservation).
why_useful: A second, independent (non-Portugal, non-Antonio) real-world PMS-style reservation dataset with lead time and cancellation status — useful as an out-of-sample cross-check for any cancellation/lead-time model built on the Antonio data, and it is India-geography which none of our held hotel datasets cover.
time_coverage: Not stated in card (Kaggle upload ~2022, underlying stay dates unspecified)
themes: Hotel booking demand datasets (Antonio Almeida Nunes and successors), hotel PMS datasets, revenue-management datasets with cancellations and lead times
why_all: A second, independent (non-Portugal, non-Antonio) real-world PMS-style reservation dataset with lead time and cancellation status — useful as an out-of-sample cross-check for any cancellation/lead-time model built on the Antonio data, and it is India-geography which none of our held hotel datasets cover.

why_useful: Another acquisition path for the same global hotel/lodging POI data described above; useful if overturemaps-py proves too slow for country-scale pulls.
duplicate_of_holding: alternative access path to OvertureMaps/data above
themes: Hotel supply data: Overture/OSM hotel POI counts, hotel pipeline datasets, lodging census (Census QSS NAICS 721), county business patterns tooling
Data-hosting mirrors pointed at from GitHub: Zenodo, Figshare, Harvard Dataverse, HuggingFace, Kaggle, Mendeley Data collections on Airbnb, STR, hotels, tourism
why_all: Another acquisition path for the same global hotel/lodging POI data described above; useful if overturemaps-py proves too slow for country-scale pulls.

Overture Maps' 'places' theme includes categorized business POIs (lodging, hotels, short-term rental agencies) globally and is updated monthly/quarterly by a Linux Foundation consortium (Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, TomTom) — a free alternative/complement to commercial POI data for building geospatial tourism-density or party-size proxies (gap #20).
